buildings.name: Town Workshop
buildings.goal: Ship improvements to Muster Town as small, reviewed pull requests
buildings.description: The building that works on Muster Town itself. Its one named manager hands out the work and its forks (copies of the manager, one per assignment) do it, each at a desk (a sandbox container) with a clone of this repo on its own branch: they run typecheck and tests, open PRs against main and merge their own green PRs. Read docs/design.md for what the town is for, docs/architecture.md for how it is built, and docs/log.md for what happened recently.
